content: Task t4 (Strict review criteria enforcement) is now ready. Please review ALL tasks (t1, t2, t3) with these strict criteria: (1) Trạng thái runtime không được ghi đè bởi config file khi restart. (2) Mọi thay đổi qua GUI (remove, status change, activate/deactivate) phải tồn tại sau restart. (3) Phân biệt 'chưa từng tồn tại' vs 'đã bị user xóa'. (4) Không silent failure. (5) Test edge cases: remove rồi add lại, change status rồi restart, add duplicate. (6) Nếu phát hiện bug, fail task. Cụ thể: kiểm tra _load_symbol_configs trong gui_bridge.py vẫn còn ghi đè symbol khi restart không? (tôi đã fix tạm nhưng cần review kỹ)

Task t6 (Review persistence and state consistency) will be ready after t5 completes. It will require reviewing the persistence implementation with strict criteria: state survives restart, YAML doesn't overwrite, thread-safe, edge cases handled.

Task t6 (Review persistence and state consistency) is now ready. t5 is complete — persistence implemented. Please review with strict criteria: (1) State survives restart — add/remove symbol, change status, restart GUI, verify state intact. (2) YAML seed config does NOT overwrite persisted state. (3) Thread-safe — no crash on concurrent access. (4) Edge cases: corrupt JSON file, remove then re-add same symbol, automation levels restored. (5) The _load_symbol_configs fix I applied earlier (only register if cfg is None) must be confirmed working alongside the new persistence layer. If any bug found, fail the task with detailed findings.
